topology_reasoning: The target is two disconnected, mirrored routed waveguides spanning the full 120 um x 4 um footprint. Each arm is a smooth S-bend route: a short horizontal lead, a monotonic vertical offset into a long central horizontal section, then the reverse bend into a short horizontal exit. The geometry is not a coupler or ring; it is a dual-arm route template with constant width and smooth corners.
function_defining_knobs: wg_width_um: sets the physical guide width seen in the black silhouette
lead_length_um: sets the horizontal lead before the first bend
center_length_um: sets the main straight span between the two S-bends
bend_radius_um: sets the bend smoothness / corner curvature
delta_length: adds real extra path length to the upper arm only so the knob moves geometry and length
image_observations: Two separate black components, vertically mirrored about the midline.
Each component has horizontal termini on the left and right and a long straight center run.
The bends are smooth, not sharp right angles.

iterations.change_made: Replaced the broken first-pass path with a simple symmetric dual-arm S-route and repaired the delta_length knob so it moves real geometry.
Matched the measured plateau and bend span more closely by shortening the center span to 54.5 um with a 17.5 um transition region.
Tested a tighter bend radius; the rasterized geometry did not materially change at compare resolution.
Tested a larger bend radius; score slipped slightly, so this was discarded.
Nudged the vertical offsets outward to fill the 4 um footprint height; size_match improved but IoU did not.
Restored the best-fitting simpler route profile and kept the measured footprint exactly at 120 um x 4 um; this is the best honest result.
